digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure / Jira Data Center verification
propositions: A vendored Dockerfile builds a test harness from the addono/jira-software-standalone base (pinned by digest) that provisions Jira 8.17.1 with mandatory AMPS flags to prevent silent startup failures.

The harness starts a real Jira Data Center instance at localhost:2990/jira with default admin credentials and exercises Personal Access Token bearer authentication against the actual /rest/pat/latest/tokens and issue endpoints.
The harness runs only on native amd64 runners due to emulation overhead and Maven artifact download time; loopback-scoped port binding prevents network exposure of well-known credentials.
Teardown assertions verify issue deletion via direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} 404 responses rather than search queries, following ADR 0037 index-independence discipline.

The suite skips cleanly without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 and a running instance, and a _live_jira_ready module-level sentinel ensures the all-skip canary detects when harness collection succeeds but execution is zero.
